mechanism: Rasagiline is a selective MAO-B inhibitor that can potentiate serotonergic and noradrenergic effects; valerian contains compounds with potential monoaminergic activity, creating additive CNS effects and theoretical serotonin syndrome risk.
action: Monitor patients for signs of serotonin syndrome (agitation, tremor, hyperthermia, hyperreflexia) and excessive sedation; consider alternative anxiolytic if significant interaction suspected; educate patients to report unusual CNS symptoms.
